<when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("piiAnonymizationEnabled") == "true")">
            
            <set-variable name="piiConfidenceThreshold" value="@(double.Parse(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("piiConfidenceThreshold", "0.8")))" />
            <set-variable name="piiEntityCategoryExclusions" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("piiEntityCategoryExclusions", ""))" />
            <set-variable name="piiDetectionLanguage" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("piiDetectionLanguage", "en"))" />
            
            
            
            <set-variable name="piiRegexMappings" value="@{
                var content = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("piiInputContent");
                var regexPatterns = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("piiRegexPatterns");
                var mappings = new JArray();
                
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(regexPatterns))
                {
                    var patterns = JArray.Parse(regexPatterns);
                    var categoryCounts = new Dictionary();
                    var processedTexts = new HashSet(); // Track already processed texts
                    
                    foreach (var pattern in patterns)
                    {
                        var regex = new Regex(pattern["pattern"].ToString());
                        var category = pattern["category"].ToString();
                        
                        if (!categoryCounts.ContainsKey(category))
                        {
                            categoryCounts[category] = 0;
                        }
                        
                        var matches = regex.Matches(content);
                        foreach (Match match in matches)
                        {
                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(match.Value))
                            {
                                // Skip matches that contain JSON-structural characters so a broad
                                // custom pattern can never corrupt the request body when replaced.
                                if (match.Value.IndexOfAny(new[] { '"', '\\', '{', '}', '[', ']', '\n', '\r' }) >= 0)
                                {
                                    continue;
                                }

                                // Skip if we already have a mapping for this text
                                if (processedTexts.Contains(match.Value))
                                {
                                    continue;
                                }
                                
                                var placeholder = $"<{category}_{categoryCounts[category]}>";
                                mappings.Add(new JObject {
                                    ["original"] = match.Value,
                                    ["placeholder"] = placeholder,
                                    ["source"] = "regex"
                                });
                                categoryCounts[category]++;
                                processedTexts.Add(match.Value); // Mark this text as processed
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                return mappings.ToString();
            }" />

            
            <set-variable name="piiRegexProcessedContent" value="@{
                var content = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("piiInputContent");
                var mappings = JArray.Parse(
                    context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("piiRegexMappings"));
                
                foreach (var mapping in mappings)
                {
                    content = content.Replace(
                        mapping["original"].ToString(),
                        mapping["placeholder"].ToString()
                    );
                }
                return content;
            }" />

            
            <set-variable name="piiInputContent" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("piiRegexProcessedContent"))" />
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            

            
            <set-variable name="piiChunks" value="@{
                var content = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("piiInputContent") ?? string.Empty;

                int maxChunk;
                if (!int.TryParse(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("piiMaxChunkSize", "5000"), out maxChunk)) { maxChunk = 5000; }
                if (maxChunk < 500) { maxChunk = 500; }
                if (maxChunk > 5120) { maxChunk = 5120; }

                int overlap;
                if (!int.TryParse(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("piiChunkOverlap", "250"), out overlap)) { overlap = 250; }
                if (overlap < 0) { overlap = 0; }
                if (overlap > maxChunk / 2) { overlap = maxChunk / 2; }

                const int maxChunksAllowed = 25; // 5 requests * 5 documents per request
                var chunks = new JArray();

                if (content.Length <= maxChunk)
                {
                    chunks.Add(content);
                }
                else
                {
                    int pos = 0;
                    while (pos < content.Length && chunks.Count < maxChunksAllowed)
                    {
                        int take = Math.Min(maxChunk, content.Length - pos);
                        int end = pos + take;

                        // Prefer breaking on whitespace near the end to avoid splitting a PII token
                        if (end < content.Length)
                        {
                            int searchFloor = pos + Math.Max(1, take - overlap);
                            for (int i = end - 1; i >= searchFloor; i--)
                            {
                                if (char.IsWhiteSpace(content[i])) { end = i; break; }
                            }
                        }

                        chunks.Add(content.Substring(pos, end - pos));
                        if (end >= content.Length) { break; }

                        // Advance with overlap so boundary-straddling entities appear whole in a chunk
                        pos = Math.Max(end - overlap, pos + 1);
                    }
                }

                return chunks.ToString();
            }" />

Content beyond the cap is NOT analyzed for PII.")

                    var lang = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("piiDetectionLanguage");
                    int start = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("piiBatchStart", 0);
                    var docs = new JArray();
                    for (int i = start; i < Math.Min(start + 5, chunks.Count); i++)
                    {
                        docs.Add(new JObject {
                            ["text"] = chunks[i].ToString(),
                            ["id"] = i.ToString(),
                            ["language"] = lang
                        });
                    }
                    var request = new JObject {
                        ["kind"] = "PiiEntityRecognition",
                        ["parameters"] = new JObject {
                            ["modelVersion"] = "latest",
                            ["redactionPolicy"] = new JObject {
                                ["policyKind"] = "CharacterMask",
                                ["redactionCharacter"] = "#"
                            }
                        },
                        ["analysisInput"] = new JObject { ["documents"] = docs }
                    };
                    return request.ToString();
                }
            
            <set-variable name="piiCurrentResponse" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("piiAnalysisResponse"))" />
            <set-variable name="piiAggregatedEntities" value="@{
                var aggregated = JArray.Parse(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("piiAggregatedEntities", "[]"));
                var response = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("piiCurrentResponse");
                if (response != null && response.StatusCode >= 200 && response.StatusCode < 300)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        var documents = JObject.Parse(response.Body.As(preserveContent: true)).SelectToken("$.results.documents") as JArray;
                        if (documents != null)
                        {
                            foreach (var doc in documents)
                            {
                                var ents = doc["entities"] as JArray;
                                if (ents != null) { foreach (var e in ents) { aggregated.Add(e); } }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    catch { }
                }
                return aggregated.ToString();
            }" />
            <set-variable name="piiAnalysisFailureReason" value="@{
                var existing = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("piiAnalysisFailureReason", "");
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(existing)) { return existing; }
                var response = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("piiCurrentResponse");
                if (response == null)
                {
                    return "PII service call failed: no response received (timeout or connectivity issue).";
                }
                if (response.StatusCode < 200 || response.StatusCode >= 300)
                {
                    var body = string.Empty;
                    try { body = response.Body?.As(preserveContent: true) ?? string.Empty; } catch { }
                    return $"PII service returned non-success status {response.StatusCode} {response.StatusReason}. Body: {body}";
                }
                try
                {
                    var parsed = JObject.Parse(response.Body.As(preserveContent: true));
                    var errors = parsed.SelectToken("$.results.errors") as JArray;
                    if (errors != null && errors.Count > 0)
                    {
                        return $"PII service reported document errors: {errors.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None)}";
                    }
                    var documents = parsed.SelectToken("$.results.documents") as JArray;
                    if (documents == null)
                    {
                        return "PII service response did not contain expected documents payload.";
                    }
                    return string.Empty;
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    return $"Failed to parse PII service response: {ex.Message}";
                }
            }" />

                    <set-variable name="piiMappings" value="@{
                        var confidenceThreshold = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("piiConfidenceThreshold");
                        var exclusions = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("piiEntityCategoryExclusions")
                            .Split(new[] { ',' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries)
                            .Select(c => c.Trim())
                            .ToList();

                        var entitiesArray = JArray.Parse(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("piiAggregatedEntities", "[]"));

                        var entities = entitiesArray
                            .Where(e => e["confidenceScore"] != null && e["confidenceScore"].Value() >= confidenceThreshold)
                            .Where(e => !exclusions.Contains(e["category"]?.ToString() ?? string.Empty))
                            .OrderByDescending(e => (e["text"]?.ToString() ?? string.Empty).Length);

                        var mappings = new JArray();
                        var categoryCounts = new Dictionary();
                        var processedTexts = new HashSet(); // Track already processed texts

                        foreach (var entity in entities) {
                            var text = (entity["text"]?.ToString() ?? string.Empty).TrimEnd('.', ',', ' ');
                            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text)) { continue; }

                            // Skip boundary artifacts: chunking the raw JSON can make the Language
                            // Service return text that spans a JSON structural token (quote/brace/etc.).
                            // A genuine PII value never contains these, so replacing such text would
                            // corrupt the request body. Dropping them keeps the anonymized body valid JSON.
                            if (text.IndexOfAny(new[] { '"', '\\', '{', '}', '[', ']', '\n', '\r' }) >= 0) { continue; }

                            // Skip if this text has already been processed
                            if (processedTexts.Contains(text)) {
                                continue;
                            }

                            var category = entity["category"].ToString();

                            if (!categoryCounts.ContainsKey(category)) {
                                categoryCounts[category] = 0;
                            }

                            var placeholder = $"<{category}_{categoryCounts[category]}>";
                            mappings.Add(new JObject {
                                ["original"] = text,
                                ["placeholder"] = placeholder
                            });

                            categoryCounts[category]++;
                            processedTexts.Add(text); // Mark this text as processed
                        }

                        return mappings.ToString();
                    }" />
                
            

            
            <set-variable name="piiMappings" value="@{
                var apiMappings = JArray.Parse(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("piiMappings") ?? "[]");
                var regexMappings = JArray.Parse(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("piiRegexMappings") ?? "[]");
                
                foreach (var mapping in regexMappings)
                {
                    apiMappings.Add(mapping);
                }
                
                return apiMappings.ToString();
            }" />

            
            <set-variable name="piiAnonymizedContent" value="@{
                var content = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("piiInputContent");
                var mappings = JArray.Parse(
                    context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("piiMappings"));

                // If the original body is JSON, guarantee the anonymized body stays valid JSON.
                // This protects request structure (and downstream model detection) even if an
                // unexpected replacement would otherwise corrupt the payload — without ever
                // forwarding unmasked PII (only the single corrupting replacement is skipped).
                bool originalIsJson = false;
                try { JToken.Parse(content); originalIsJson = true; } catch { originalIsJson = false; }

                foreach (var mapping in mappings) {
                    var original = mapping["original"].ToString();
                    var placeholder = mapping["placeholder"].ToString();
                    if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(original)) { continue; }

                    var candidate = content.Replace(original, placeholder);

                    if (originalIsJson)
                    {
                        try { JToken.Parse(candidate); }
                        catch { continue; }
                    }

                    content = candidate;
                }

                return content;
            }" />
